title: St. Cecilia

panels.shot: The rooftop helipad in the storm. Krieg sits against the landing-light mast; his defibrillator paddles spark in a puddle. Lightning behind.

lines.text: The doctor finally had a patient he couldn't save.

panels.shot: Close-up. Krieg's phone on wet concrete: 'Silence the bartender. — A.V.' Beside it, a red-sealed envelope: Winter Gala, Royal Conservatory.

lines.text: A.V. Augusta Vane. The police commissioner.

panels.shot: Room 314 at dawn, grey light, the storm passing. Mags awake and weak; Nero rests his head on her bed.

lines.speaker: Mags
lines.text: I saw her men at the club. Taking Malaspina's money. That's why.

panels.shot: Elias at the window, back to camera. Police HQ glows across the river.

lines.text: The law owned the guns. Now it owned a debt to me.

panels.shot: The ward payphone rings in the empty corridor, its receiver shaking on the hook.
